description: ☰ → Terminal: a full-window view over the chat, as the Kubernetes view is, of tabs of Multiplex terminals, each run on a host by its host process (wire's terminal op) and drawn here. It can move out to a window of its own (Multiplex's look) and back.

parts.name: bar
parts.shows: The view's top bar: "Terminal" (heading), the shown terminal's host by name (dim), then flat buttons New tab and Move to Its Own Window, and a round Close (×).

actions.does: A new terminal on the host picked in the window's host dropdown, in a new tab

actions.by: click Move to Its Own Window
actions.does: The tabs move to a window titled Multiplex (its frame, a New tab button in its header); the view closes. Closing that window puts them back here, shown.
Closes the view; its terminals keep running and are there when it opens again

parts.name: tabs
parts.shows: A tab per terminal, titled by its program (else its host); the strip only with more than one tab, as Emission's and Multiplex's. A tab whose program ended while a Bot was at it says (ended) and stays till closed; any other closes as its program ends.

parts.name: terminal
parts.shows: The terminal (VTE), its edges glowing in the accent while a Bot is at its terminal tools there. What's typed goes to the program on its host. A host that can't be reached says why in it.
